name: JoAi: Create Contact

description.en: Add someone to your address book with name, email, phone, company, and tags. If the person already exists (same name, email, or phone), the existing contact is reused — no duplicates.
description.de: Lege jemanden im Adressbuch an — mit Name, E-Mail, Telefon, Firma und Tags. Gibt es die Person schon (gleicher Name, gleiche E-Mail oder gleiches Telefon), wird der bestehende Kontakt verwendet — ohne Duplikate.
description.es: Añade a alguien a tu agenda con nombre, correo, teléfono, empresa y etiquetas. Si la persona ya existe (mismo nombre, correo o teléfono), se reutiliza el contacto — sin duplicados.
description.fr: Ajoute quelqu’un à ton carnet d’adresses avec nom, e-mail, téléphone, entreprise et tags. Si la personne existe déjà (même nom, e-mail ou téléphone), le contact existant est réutilisé — sans doublons.
description.ro: Adaugă pe cineva în agenda ta cu nume, e-mail, telefon, firmă și etichete. Dacă persoana există deja (același nume, e-mail sau telefon), se folosește contactul existent — fără duplicate.
description.it: Aggiungi qualcuno alla rubrica con nome, e-mail, telefono, azienda e tag. Se la persona esiste già (stesso nome, e-mail o telefono), viene riusato il contatto esistente — senza duplicati.

bot: Find-or-create a contact by name, email, or phone. Prefer email and phone when known. Before proposing a new contact from an inbound message or a person you only know by name: briefly research them (web search) and fill verified fields (employer, title, website, LinkedIn/socials, location). Never invent employer/company from networking groups, events, interests, or communities mentioned in a message — put those in tags or notes instead. Leave company/title/website empty when unverified. If a match is returned, do not create another contact — use contact update for non-empty field changes. To set a profile image, upload media first (media_upload) then pass the media ID in avatar as a JSON array. On an existing match, avatar is only set if the contact has none yet.

inputs.name: Name
inputs.bot: The contact's name — first name, full name, or nickname.

inputs.name: Email
inputs.bot: The contact's email address, if mentioned.

inputs.name: Phone
inputs.bot: The contact's phone number, if mentioned.

inputs.name: Company
inputs.bot: Employer or company the person works for / owns — only when confirmed (message says they work there, or research verifies it). Never use networking groups, events, communities, or interests (e.g. 'Women Connect Hollabrunn') as company; put those in tags or notes.

inputs.name: Title
inputs.bot: Job title or role (e.g., CEO, Elementarpädagogin) only when stated or verified by research. Do not invent.

inputs.name: Notes
inputs.bot: Context worth keeping: how you met, interests, networking groups, open requests. Prefer notes over stuffing non-employer orgs into company.

inputs.name: Tags
inputs.bot: Tags to categorize this contact (e.g., Interessent, client, networking-group name). Networking groups and communities belong here or in notes — not in company. Provide as a comma-separated list.

inputs.name: Website
inputs.bot: Personal or business website URL when mentioned or verified by research.

inputs.name: Birthday
inputs.bot: The contact's birthday in YYYY-MM-DD format, if mentioned.

inputs.name: Socials
inputs.bot: Pass a platform-to-URL object from research or the message, e.g. {"linkedin":"https://linkedin.com/in/name","instagram":"https://instagram.com/name"}. Do not pass an array of platform/url objects. Prefer LinkedIn when researching a new lead.

inputs.name: Avatar

description.en: Profile image media IDs as a JSON array (upload media first)
description.es: IDs de media de imagen de perfil como array JSON (sube el media primero)
description.fr: IDs média de la photo de profil en tableau JSON (uploader le média d’abord)
description.ro: ID-uri media pentru imaginea de profil ca array JSON (încarcă media mai întâi)
description.it: ID media dell'immagine profilo come array JSON (carica prima il media)

inputs.bot: JSON array of team media hash IDs for the contact avatar, e.g. ["abc123"]. Upload with media_upload first, then pass the returned media ID here. On an existing contact match, only applied if they have no avatar yet.

inputs.name: Team

description.en: Team for this action (defaults to the current team)
description.de: Team für diese Aktion (Standard: aktuelles Team)
description.es: Equipo para esta acción (por defecto el actual)
description.fr: Équipe pour cette action (par défaut : l’équipe actuelle)
description.ro: Echipa pentru această acțiune (implicit: echipa curentă)
description.it: Team per questa azione (predefinito: il team attuale)

inputs.bot: The slug of the team to operate on. Omit to use the current team.
